tools.name: list_designs
tools.description: List ForeverVow's Indian wedding invitation designs (free and premium), each with a short description and a sample invite link. Use it to help the couple choose a design before create_invite.

tools.name: create_invite
tools.description: Make a free Indian wedding invite on ForeverVow with the couple's names and functions (haldi, mehendi, sangeet, wedding, reception…). Returns a link that opens the finished draft in the ForeverVow editor, where the couple can change anything, add photos, an RSVP page and a song, then publish one lin

tools.name: get_invitation_messages
tools.description: Ready-to-send wedding invitation messages for WhatsApp in English, Hindi and Hinglish (formal, warm, for friends, reminder). Replace the sample names, date and city with the couple's.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_invitation_messages · Public sink: create_invite, get_invitation_messages.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_invitation_messages · Public sink: create_invite, get_invitation_messages

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
